subject: general
question: Which of the following festivals is celebrated in Madhya Pradesh?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Khajuraho Dance Festival**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• The Khajuraho Dance Festival is a prestigious annual event held in the state of Madhya Pradesh.
 
• The festival takes place in the Khajuraho temple complex, which is renowned for its stunning ancient temples and intricate sculptures.
 
• This festival showcases a variety of classical dance forms of India, including Kathak, Bharatanatyam, Odissi, and Kuchipudi.
 
• The event attracts numerous tourists and dance enthusiasts from all over the world, celebrating India's rich cultural heritage.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Thaipusam Festival:**

 
 
• It is a Hindu festival celebrated mostly by the Tamil community in India and abroad.
 
• This festival is dedicated to Lord Murugan, the Hindu god of war, and is observed with various rituals and processions.
 
 
 
• **Jaisalmer Desert Festival:**
 
 
• This festival takes place in the city of Jaisalmer in Rajasthan, India.
 
• It is celebrated with cultural events, including camel races, traditional music, dance performances, and the showcasing of local crafts.
 
 
 
• **Bihu Festival:**
 
 
• The Bihu festival is an important cultural festival of Assam, India.
 
• There are three types of Bihu: Rongali Bihu, Kongali Bihu, and Bhogali Bihu, each marking different agricultural cycles.
 
• Rongali Bihu is the most prominent and marks the Assamese New Year, celebrated with dance, music, and traditional feasts.
 
 
 
• **Khajuraho Dance Festival:**
 
 
• The festival is held annually in February in the Khajuraho temple complex in Madhya Pradesh.
 
• It is organized by the Madhya Pradesh Kala Parishad (MP Department of Culture).
 
• The festival aims to promote and preserve the rich cultural traditions of India's classical dance forms.
 
• The Khajuraho temples, a UNESCO World Heritage site, provide a stunning backdrop for the performances.
